answer: The ocean cap is enforced at intake and sonnet shows the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a meadow tag. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch however much capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 5 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
